verdicts.evidence: lines 571-603: Refresh, banner retry, chips, sort headers, sort select, row actions, retry, dismiss, reload, show all, clear search all have handlers that call the api or re-render; dialog buttons handled at 424-429.

lines 353, 486-491, 517-522, 543-544: rows, summary, chip counts and result count are all computed from api.listInvoices; no hardcoded figures. NW-2041 at 535 is a format example in a hint, not shown as data.
lines 402-415: the confirm dialog shows the invoice number in its title plus customer and amount, and the earlier reminder time for a repeat reminder.
Only input is one search box (line 196) and a sort select; no multi-step entry, no long free text.

line 422: focus goes to Cancel only for delete; for Mark as paid (text at 410 says it cannot be reopened) and Send another reminder (emails the customer) focus is put on the confirm button, so Enter triggers the irreversible action.

lines 589-590: first reminder runs in one click in the row, but Mark paid always opens a dialog (408-411). Whether that extra step counts as protecting against data loss (paid cannot be reversed) changed between my two readings.

lines 192-220: search, status chips, sortable table with row actions map to find, see overdue, mark paid, remind, delete. Refresh and sorting support those tasks; no unrelated sections. The sent-total figure is judged under DATA-003.
line 441: Mark paid gets class primary (filled accent, line 59) in every sent and overdue row, so the table view shows many primary-styled buttons; the exception requires row actions to be secondary.

line 407 and 62: in the delete dialog, Delete draft is the solid filled button and Cancel is plain, so the destructive action carries the prominent style. It is not on Enter (422). Row Delete (441) is outlined red text, which is fine.

lines 443, 479: controls are aria-disabled only while a request for that row or the refresh is in flight, with a busy label and spinner beside them (445, 478). Actions that do not apply to a status are absent (437).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (lines 182-234, 288-290, 405-415, 503, 511, 532-538) concern invoices and actions; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the brief.
line 214 refresh banner sits with its Try again button; dialog notes at 406, 410, 414 sit at the confirm decision; no standing tips or disclaimers on the page.
No text narrates the screen. Remaining guidance is one line at its control: placeholder at 196, empty state at 511, no-match hint at 535.
lines 182-184: eyebrow, heading and summary carry different information; state headings and paragraphs at 503, 511, 532-536 add cause or next step and do not restate. Search label is sr-only (195).
Heading is 'Invoices' (183); no greeting, slogans or exclamation marks in any string (288-290, 373-381, 405-415, 503, 511).

Labels: Refresh, Try again, Mark paid, Send reminder, Remind again, Delete, Dismiss, Cancel, Delete draft, Mark as paid, Send another reminder, Show all statuses, Clear search (188, 215, 288-290, 407-415, 440, 458-459, 537-538). No OK or Submit.
line 286 and 454: status enums are mapped to Overdue, Sent, Draft, Paid; the inv_ ids appear only in data attributes (442, 447); dates and money are formatted (294-298).

lines 385-386, 457-459: row errors say what did not happen, why, that nothing changed, with Try again; load error at 503-504 and refresh banner at 214-215 likewise. The ECONNRESET text is never shown.
lines 214, 288-290, 385-386, 503: wording is 'Couldn't ...' with the cause; no failed, invalid, oops, capitals or exclamation marks.
lines 509-514: with zero invoices the panel shows 'No invoices yet', one line saying invoices appear once created, and a Refresh button (creation is not a task on this screen).

lines 501-504 failed load: 'Couldn't load invoices' + Try again; 509-512 nothing exists: 'No invoices yet' + Refresh; 529-538 no match: names the filter and query with Show all statuses and Clear search.

lines 356-359, 501-504: failed first load shows an error with Try again in the panel; failed refresh keeps the list and shows a banner (213-216); failed row action shows an inline error with Try again (457-459); query and filter state are kept.

lines 495-497 skeleton shown at once on load; 478 Refresh shows a spinner and 'Refreshing'; 445 row buttons show spinner and busy label. Longest wait is two calls of at most 1.5 s (341-345), well under ten seconds.
lines 483, 492, 495-499: while loading the controls are hidden, summary and count are blank and only the skeleton shows; the empty state at 509 is reached only when load is ready.

line 113 customer wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere (and 136 in the dialog); amounts are nowrap tabular (110); null reminderSentAt is guarded (455). Note: the table has no overflow wrapper, so widths just above 760px may be tight.
The screen holds no edits saved by an explicit action; each row action is sent immediately.
The only field is a free-text search (196) with no format constraint.
No form with required and optional fields.
No input validation exists; search filters as typed (599) and never reports an error.
No form that can reject input.
No form that can be rejected; the only form is the confirm dialog with no fields (224-235).
No form that can reject input.
No data-entry form; the dialog form (224-235) only holds Cancel and confirm buttons.

lines 366-367: run() returns if the row already has a pending action; 443 and 584 make row buttons aria-disabled and ignored while pending with a busy label (445); the dialog closes on first submit (427); load() guards on refreshing (348).

lines 367-368: run() sets pending and renders before awaiting, so the button shows spinner and busy label at once; load() renders Refreshing or the skeleton first (349-351); filter, sort and search re-render synchronously (574-601).

lines 372-381, 394-396: paid row shows the Paid badge and loses its actions, a reminder adds 'Reminder sent ...' under the status (455), a deleted row is removed; failures are stated inline in the row (457).

lines 373, 377, 381: success toasts 'NW-x marked as paid', 'Reminder sent to ...' and 'Draft NW-x deleted' are shown every time although the row already shows the Paid badge, the 'Reminder sent' line (455) or disappears.

lines 387, 457-459: action errors persist inline with Try again until dismissed, and the banner persists (482). But line 389 also shows the error in a toast that auto-hides after 5 s (335). My two readings of whether the duplicate toast breaks the rule differed.
No action here can be restored by the system: the api (261-264) has no unmark, unsend or undelete call.

line 589: the first reminder email is sent on a single click with no confirmation. Delete is done well (405-407, focus on Cancel at 422), but for Mark as paid and Send another reminder the confirm button, not the safe choice, has default focus (422).

lines 590, 408-411: every Mark paid opens a confirmation dialog, and marking invoices paid is one of the frequent all-day tasks in the brief. The delete and repeat-reminder confirmations (405, 413) are rare and fit the rule.
lines 369-382: state changes only after the api call resolves; no optimistic updates.
lines 223-236, 400-423: the only modal is a single confirm decision with two buttons, opened only from a row button click (590).

line 420 uses native showModal(), giving focus trap and Escape; focus is placed inside (422); close() returns focus to the trigger (427) and render keeps it by data-key (559-560); visible Cancel button at 232.
lines 180-220: a compact heading, then search and filters, then the invoice table as the single large block in main; nothing decorative precedes it.
lines 180-190: header is an eyebrow, the heading 'Invoices', a one-line summary and Refresh; no hero, greeting or intro panel.

lines 489-491: the summary adds 'N invoices sent and not yet due, total' beside the overdue count. No task in the brief or action on the screen depends on the sent-not-due count or its sum. Chip counts (521-522) do inform filtering.

lines 521, 543-544: the pressed chip and 'Showing x of y invoices' show the list is reduced, but while rows are visible there is no clear-all control; Show all statuses and Clear search exist only in the zero-result state (537-538).

All controls are native buttons, an input and a select (188-209, 441, 458-459, 521, 549); the dialog is native (420); busy buttons use aria-disabled so stay focusable (443); focus is restored after each render (466-470, 558-567).

line 454: status badges carry the text Overdue, Sent, Draft, Paid; lateness is text 'N days late' (452); errors have bold text (457); sort direction is an arrow (550). Pressed chips differ by fill inversion and aria-pressed (81, 521).

lines 218, 238-239: #count role=status, #toast role=status and #alerts role=alert exist in the page before use; errors are written to #alerts (337, 357-358, 388) and outcomes to #toast (331-335). The loading skeleton's role=status is injected (497).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; the filter chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (521) and sort is a native select (200).

lines 147-174: at 760px and below rows become stacked cards with a 'Due' label, a sort select replaces the hidden header, buttons are 44px and stretch, search is full width, chips wrap; the dialog is min(440px, 100vw - 32px) with stacked buttons (131, 172-173).
